aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the TIP 864/884 versus TIP 844 theme but grouping and outcomes are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor mixes tip type with repair state and trial rounds.
TIP 864 vision outcome lacks normal comparison rows and judgement.
TIP 884 vision outcome compares partial trials and repair-after rows instead of the aggregate result.
Function check outcome is unjudged despite cited normal and test rows.
Spurious measurement outcomes come from headers or pooled defect columns.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to tip type: normal TIP 844 versus test TIP 864 and TIP 884.
Keep trial round and before/after repair as subgroup or process-stage context.
Rebuild vision outcomes using aggregate before-repair NG rates and cited normal rows for each section.
Judge function check TIP 864 and TIP 884 against TIP 844 using rows 73, 75, 77, and conclusion row 79.
Remove header-derived measurement outcomes unless a real dimensional/spec table exists.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient; key comparison and conclusion rows are missing or misused.
